name: Wilhelm II
contribution: The last German Emperor from 1888 until his abdication in 1918.
legacy: Despite strengthening Germany's position as a great power in the short term by building a powerful navy and promoting scientific innovation within its borders, this person's erratic foreign policy greatly antagonized the international community and is considered by many to have led to the fall of the German Empire

photo_credit: Studio of Thomas Heinrich Voigt · Public domain

checks.lead: Wilhelm II (Friedrich Wilhelm Viktor Albert; 27 January 1859 – 4 June 1941) was the last German Emperor from 1888 until his abdication in 1918. His fall from power marked the end of the German Empire as well as the Hohenzollern dynasty's 400-year rule over Prussia.
